description: This source file defines the SimSpaceWeaverClient PHP class used for interacting with the AWS SimSpace Weaver service. It includes method annotations for various asynchronous and synchronous service operations, and extends the AwsClient class.

classes.name: SimSpaceWeaverClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with AWS SimSpace Weaver service, providing methods to manage simulations and applications.

methods.name: createSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of the current simulation state.

methods.name: createSnapshotAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a snapshot of the current simulation state.

methods.name: deleteApp
methods.description: Deletes an application from the simulation.

methods.name: deleteAppAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes an application from the simulation.

methods.name: describeApp
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific application.

methods.name: describeAppAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details about a specific application.

methods.name: describeSimulation
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific simulation.

methods.name: describeSimulationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details about a specific simulation.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists the tags for a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
